name: Alok
introEn: Active aura that heals Alok and nearby allies, boosts their movement speed and drops music notes.
introHi: eka Active Aura banaataa hai, jo Alok aura aasapaasa ke teammates ko heal karataa hai, unakee Movement Speed badhaataa hai aura Music Notes giraataa hai।
currentEn: Creates a 5m aura that increases movement speed by 15% and restores 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. While the aura is active, a music note drops 2m behind Alok every 2 seconds and lasts 5 seconds. Teammates who pick up a note gain 15% movement speed and 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. Multiple Drop the Beat auras do not stack.

Music Note kitanee dera rahataa hai
Note uthaane para milane vaalaa Bonus

notesHi: Alok kee apanee Skilll active hone para teammates ke Alok Aura se use koee phaayadaa naheen milataa (OB53)। Movement Speed kee eka global maximum limit hai; Skillls, items aura events se milane vaale bonuses isa limit ko paara naheen kara sakate (OB54)। OB47 se sabhee players ke lie Awakened Skilll ne original Skilll kee jagaha le lee hai; donon appearances aba bhee available hain।

name: Nairi
introEn: Passive ability that restores deployed Gloo Wall durability and provides limited HP recovery to nearby teammates.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo lagaaee gaee Gloo Wall kee Durability vaapasa badhaatee hai aura aasapaasa ke teammates ko thodee HP Recovery detee hai।
currentEn: After a Gloo Wall is deployed, it restores 160 durability per second during a 1.5-second effect window.
Teammates within 5m recover 5 HP per second during the effect window.
currentHi: Gloo Wall lagaane ke baada 1.5-second Effect Window ke dauraana usakee Durability hara second 160 badhatee hai।
isa Effect Window ke dauraana 5m ke andara maujooda teammates hara second 5 HP recover karate hain।

rows.hi: Deploy karane ke baada Effect Window
paasa ke Teammates kee HP Recovery

notesEn: The teammate-healing effect cannot be stacked by deploying multiple Gloo Walls.
OB42 stated a maximum of 40 HP per teammate per Gloo Wall; later patch notes do not explicitly reconfirm whether that cap remains.
Garena does not publish a current maximum HP recovery total per teammate per Gloo Wall.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: kaee Gloo Walls lagaane se Teammate Healing Effect stack naheen hotaa।
OB42 men hara Gloo Wall se hara teammate ko maximum 40 HP milane kee baata kahee gaee thee; baada ke Patch Notes yaha confirm naheen karate ki yaha cap aba bhee laagoo hai yaa naheen।
Garena, hara teammate ko eka Gloo Wall se milane vaalee current maximum HP Recovery publish naheen karataa।
Garena isa Passive Ability kaa numeric Cooldown publish naheen karataa।
historyEn: OB36 (21 Sep 2022): Gloo Wall durability restoration increased from 20/22/24/26/28/30% to 40/42/44/46/48/50% of current durability every 1s.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Ice Iron documented as restoring 250 durability/s to deployed Gloo Walls when hit; teammates within 5m recovered 20 HP/s, with a 40 HP per-teammate cap per wall.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Gloo Wall durability restoration reduced from 250 to 150 per second.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Durability restoration increased from 150 to 160 per second; teammate recovery changed from 20 to 10 HP/s, within 3s after deployment.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): The post-deployment effect window changed from 3s to 2s.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): The effect window changed from 2s to 1.5s and teammate recovery changed from 10 to 5 HP/s.
historyHi: OB36 (21 Sep 2022): Gloo Wall Durability Recovery ko hara 1s men current Durability ke 20/22/24/26/28/30% se badhaakara 40/42/44/46/48/50% kiyaa gayaa।

OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Ice Iron men darja kiyaa gayaa ki Hit hone para deployed Gloo Walls 250 Durability/s recover karatee hain; 5m ke andara teammates 20 HP/s recover karate the, hara teammate ke lie hara wall para 40 HP cap ke saatha।
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Gloo Wall Durability Recovery 250 se ghataakara 150 per second kee gaee।
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Durability Recovery 150 se badhaakara 160 per second kee gaee; Teammate Recovery 20 se ghataakara 10 HP/s aura deployment ke baada 3s taka kee gaee।

OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Effect Window 2s se ghataakara 1.5s aura Teammate Recovery 10 se ghataakara 5 HP/s kee gaee।

source.label: Garena — Official Nairi full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: For a planned hold or rotation, deploy the Gloo Wall at the cover point your squad intends to use so its short restoration window begins while the team stabilizes.
Keep teammates within 5m during the brief HP-recovery window; call the regroup before spreading into separate angles.
Treat Ice Iron as a short support window, not sustained healing. Time the wall deployment around the squad's move rather than relying on repeated walls to stack recovery.
tacticalHi: Squad ko kisee jagaha hold yaa rotate karanaa ho, to Gloo Wall usee cover point para lagaaen jahaan team rukane vaalee hai, taaki team ke settle hote samaya usakee chhotee Recovery Window shuroo ho।
HP Recovery kee chhotee Window ke dauraana teammates ko 5m ke andara rakhen; alaga-alaga angles para phailane se pahale regroup call den।

Ice Iron ko thode samaya ke Support Effect kee taraha len, lagaataara Healing kee taraha naheen। baara-baara Gloo Wall lagaakara Recovery stack hone kee ummeeda na karen; deployment kaa samaya squad kee movement ke hisaaba se rakhen।
strengthsEn: Adds a short durability-restoration window to deployed Gloo Walls, helping the squad maintain temporary cover.
Provides nearby teammates with a small HP-recovery window when they stay within 5m.
strengthsHi: Deployed Gloo Walls ko thode samaya ke lie extra Durability milatee hai, jisase squad kaa temporary cover banaa raha sakataa hai।
5m ke andara rahane vaale teammates ko HP Recovery kee chhotee Window milatee hai।
limitationsEn: The post-deployment effect window is only 1.5 seconds, so timing matters.
The teammate-healing effect does not stack from deploying multiple Gloo Walls.
Garena does not publish a current per-wall maximum HP recovery total for each teammate.
limitationsHi: Deployment ke baada Effect Window sirpha 1.5 seconds kee hai, isalie timing jarooree hai।
kaee Gloo Walls lagaane se Teammate Healing Effect stack naheen hotaa।
Garena, hara teammate ke lie eka Gloo Wall se milane vaalee current maximum HP Recovery publish naheen karataa।

name: Otho
introEn: Passive ability that marks nearby enemy teammates after a knockdown and applies a short movement-speed reduction.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo Knockdown ke baada aasapaasa maujooda Enemy teammates ko mark karatee hai aura thode samaya ke lie unakee Movement Speed kama karatee hai।
currentEn: After Otho knocks down an enemy, Memory Mist marks that enemy's teammates within 20m of the knocked-down enemy.
Marked enemies have their movement speed reduced by 25% for 3 seconds.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, Memory Mist marks and slows the attacker and their teammates.
currentHi: Otho ke kisee Enemy ko Knockdown karane ke baada Memory Mist, Knock hue Enemy se 20m ke andara maujooda usake teammates ko mark karatee hai।
Mark hue Enemy kee Movement Speed 3 seconds ke lie 25% kama ho jaatee hai।
agara Otho ko koee paasa kaa Enemy Knockdown karataa hai, to Memory Mist usa attacker aura usake teammates ko mark karake unakee Speed kama karatee hai।
notesEn: The 20m range is stated for the enemy-knockdown trigger. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
Garena does not publish the maximum number of players that Memory Mist can mark.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karane vaale Trigger ke lie 20m Range dee gaee hai। khuda Knockdown hone vaale Trigger kee alaga numeric Range Garena publish naheen karataa।
Memory Mist kitane maximum players ko mark kara sakatee hai, yaha Garena publish naheen karataa।
Garena isa Passive Ability kaa numeric Cooldown publish naheen karataa।
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum reveal range increased from 50m to 75m; teammate information-sharing duration increased from 4s to 6s.

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist reworked: after knocking down an enemy, it marks enemies within 20m of the knocked-down enemy and slows them by 25% for 4s; when Otho is knocked down, it also marks and slows nearby enemies.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): The mark-and-slow duration changed from 4s to 3s.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Reveal Range 50m se badhaakara 75m; Teammates ke saatha Information Sharing Duration 4s se badhaakara 6s kee gaee।

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist ko rework kiyaa gayaa: Enemy ko Knockdown karane ke baada vaha Knock hue Enemy se 20m ke andara maujooda Enemy ko mark karatee hai aura 4s ke lie unakee Speed 25% kama karatee hai; Otho ke Knockdown hone para bhee aasapaasa ke Enemy mark aura slow hote hain।
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Mark aura Slow kee Duration 4s se ghataakara 3s kee gaee।

source.label: Garena — Official Otho full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After a knockdown, use the 20m mark around the downed opponent to call the nearby enemy positions before the squad commits to a follow-up.
The 3-second slow creates a brief timing advantage: coordinate a reposition, safer angle change or reset while the marked group is slowed.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, immediately communicate the trigger so teammates know the attacker and nearby group have been marked and slowed.
tacticalHi: Knockdown ke baada down hue opponent ke aasapaasa 20m men mark hue Enemy kee location call karen, phira squad ko aage badhaaen।
3-second Slow se thode samaya kaa advantage milataa hai: isa dauraana position badalen, behatara angle len yaa reset karen।
agara Otho ko koee paasa kaa Enemy Knockdown karataa hai, to turnta teammates ko bataaen, taaki unhen pataa rahe ki attacker aura aasapaasa kee team mark aura slow ho chukee hai।
strengthsEn: A knockdown can reveal the downed enemy's nearby teammates, giving the squad information for its next decision.
The 25% movement-speed reduction can briefly disrupt an enemy group's reposition.
The self-knockdown trigger can also mark and slow the nearby attacker and their teammates.
strengthsHi: Knockdown se down hue Enemy ke aasapaasa maujooda teammates kee location pataa chala sakatee hai, jisase squad agalaa phaisalaa le sakatee hai।
25% Movement Speed Reduction kuchha samaya ke lie Enemy team kee repositioning bigaada sakatee hai।
khuda Knockdown hone para bhee yaha paasa ke attacker aura usake teammates ko mark aura slow kara sakatee hai।
limitationsEn: The main trigger requires Otho to knock down an enemy; it is not a continuous scan.
The published 20m range is measured from the knocked-down enemy. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
The mark-and-slow effect lasts only 3 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum mark count.
limitationsHi: mukhya Trigger ke lie Otho ko Enemy Knockdown karanaa jarooree hai; yaha lagaataara chalane vaalaa Scan naheen hai।
bataaee gaee 20m Range, Knock hue Enemy se maapee jaatee hai। khuda Knockdown hone vaale Trigger kee alaga numeric Range Garena publish naheen karataa।
Mark aura Slow Effect sirpha 3 seconds rahataa hai aura maximum mark count Garena publish naheen karataa।

name: Leon
introEn: Passive ability that restores HP after Leon survives combat.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo Combat se bacha nikalane ke baada Leon ko HP vaapasa detee hai।
currentEn: After surviving combat, Leon recovers 60 HP at a rate of 4 HP per second for 15 seconds.
currentHi: Combat se bachane ke baada Leon 15 seconds taka hara second 4 HP kee dara se kula 60 HP recover karataa hai।
notesEn: The recovery begins after the game registers that Leon has survived combat.
Garena does not publish the exact combat-disengagement timer that determines when the recovery trigger begins.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Game dvaaraa Leon ke Combat se bacha nikalane kee pushti karane ke baada Recovery shuroo hotee hai।
Recovery Trigger shuroo hone kaa exact Combat-disengagement timer Garena publish naheen karataa।
Garena isa Passive Ability kaa numeric Cooldown publish naheen karataa।
historyEn: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum recovery increased from 30 HP to 60 HP; recovery rate changed from 5 to 4 HP/s; maximum recovery duration changed from 6s to 15s.
historyHi: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum Recovery 30 HP se badhaakara 60 HP kee gaee; Recovery Rate 5 se ghataakara 4 HP/s aura Maximum Recovery Duration 6s se badhaakara 15s kee gaee।

source.label: Garena — Official Leon full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After an engagement ends, create space behind cover and let Buzzer Beater's recovery tick before taking another contested position.
Use the recovery window to regroup with teammates and prepare the next rotation instead of treating the passive as an emergency instant heal.
Call out when you are disengaging so the squad can avoid leaving Leon isolated while the recovery is taking effect.
tacticalHi: Engagement khatma hone ke baada cover ke peechhe jagaha banaaen aura doosaree contested position lene se pahale Buzzer Beater kee Recovery hone den।
Recovery Window kaa istemaala teammates ke saatha regroup aura agalee rotation kee taiyaaree ke lie karen; ise turnta milane vaalee Emergency Heal na samajhen।
jaba aapa fight se disengage kara rahe hon to teammates ko call den, taaki Recovery ke dauraana Leon akelaa na chhoote।
strengthsEn: Provides up to 60 HP of recovery after surviving combat without requiring a manual activation.
The 15-second recovery window can support a reset between engagements.
strengthsHi: Manual Activation ke binaa Combat se bachane ke baada maximum 60 HP Recovery milatee hai।
15-second Recovery Window do engagements ke beecha reset karane men madada kara sakatee hai।
limitationsEn: Recovery is gradual at 4 HP/s, not an instant HP burst.
The trigger is tied to surviving combat; Garena does not publish the exact disengagement timer.
It does not replace cover or teammate support during an active engagement.
limitationsHi: Recovery dheere-dheere 4 HP/s kee dara se hotee hai, turnta HP naheen milatee।
Trigger, Combat se bachane para nirbhara hai; exact disengagement timer Garena publish naheen karataa।
Active Engagement ke dauraana yaha cover yaa teammate support kee jagaha naheen letee।

name: Koda
introEn: Active ability that activates an aurora effect, increases movement speed and periodically reveals enemies behind cover.
introHi: eka Active Ability, jo Aurora Effect chaaloo karatee hai, Movement Speed badhaatee hai aura samaya-samaya para cover ke peechhe maujooda Enemy ko reveal karatee hai।
currentEn: Activates the Aurora power for 8 seconds and increases movement speed by 15%.
Reveals enemies behind cover within 50m every 1 second; crouching or prone enemies cannot be detected.
While parachuting, highlights enemy locations within the field of view, but the effect is not shared with teammates.
currentHi: 8 seconds ke lie Aurora Power activate hotee hai aura Movement Speed 15% badha jaatee hai।
hara 1 second men 50m ke andara cover ke peechhe maujooda Enemy reveal hote hain; crouch yaa prone Enemy detect naheen hote।
Parachuting ke dauraana Field of View men aane vaalee Enemy kee locations highlight hotee hain, lekina yaha Effect teammates ke saatha share naheen hotaa।
notesEn: The parachuting highlight is visible only to Koda's user.

OB54 lists two optional BR Skill Boosts, separate from the base Aurora Vision values: Synced Vision marks enemies revealed during the first detection interval for 3 seconds and shares the information with teammates; Imprinted Vision applies up to 3 stacks, with 10 additional DMG per stack when the imprints are activated by an attack.

notesHi: Parachuting ke dauraana milane vaalaa Highlight sirpha Koda ko dikhaaee detaa hai।

OB54 men do optional BR Skilll Boosts die gae hain, jo base Aurora Vision values se alaga hain: Synced Vision, pahale Detection Interval men reveal hue Enemy ko 3 seconds ke lie mark karake jaanakaaree teammates ke saatha share karataa hai; Imprinted Vision maximum 3 stacks lagaataa hai, aura Attack se Imprints activate hone para hara stack 10 extra DMG detaa hai।
donon Skilll Boost options men se sirpha eka chunaa jaa sakataa hai। OB54 men base Duration, Movement Speed Bonus, Detection Range yaa Cooldown naheen badale gae।

OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 15%; cooldown reduced from 60s to 45s.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora duration reduced from 10s to 8s.

historyHi: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda ko 10s Aurora Duration, +10% Movement Speed, hara 1s men 50m Detection, 60s Cooldown aura teammates ke saatha share na hone vaale Parachuting Highlight ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa।
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement Speed Bonus 10% se badhaakara 15%; Cooldown 60s se ghataakara 45s kiyaa gayaa।

OB54 (23 Jun 2026): do optional BR Skilll Boosts phira se die gae: Synced Vision (3s Shared Mark) aura Imprinted Vision (maximum 3 stacks; activate hone para hara stack 10 DMG)।

Use the 15% movement-speed bonus to reposition with teammates while the detection window is active; do not assume every enemy will be revealed.
During parachuting, use the personal field-of-view highlights to call out visible locations because that information is not shared automatically with teammates.
tacticalHi: Contested rotation men jaane yaa snbhaavita enemy cover check karane se pahale Aurora Vision activate karen, phira hara reveal kee jaanakaaree squad ko saapha callouts men den।
Detection Window active rahate hue 15% Movement Speed Bonus kaa istemaala teammates ke saatha reposition karane men karen; yaha na maanen ki hara Enemy reveal ho jaaegaa।
Parachuting ke dauraana Field of View men dikhane vaalee locations call karen, kyonki yaha jaanakaaree apane aapa teammates ke saatha share naheen hotee।
strengthsEn: Periodically reveals enemies behind cover within 50m, excluding crouching and prone targets.
Adds a 15% movement-speed bonus during the 8-second Aurora window.
Can highlight visible enemy locations during parachuting for the user.
strengthsHi: 50m ke andara cover ke peechhe maujooda Enemy ko samaya-samaya para reveal karatee hai; crouching aura prone targets detect naheen hote।
8-second Aurora Window ke dauraana 15% Movement Speed Bonus detee hai।
Parachuting ke dauraana user ko visible enemy locations highlight kara sakatee hai।
limitationsEn: The active window lasts 8 seconds and the cooldown is 45 seconds.
Crouching and prone enemies cannot be detected by the behind-cover scan.
Parachuting highlights are not shared with teammates.
OB54 Skill Boosts are optional BR enhancements and are separate from the base Aurora Vision values.
limitationsHi: Active Window 8 seconds kee hai aura Cooldown 45 seconds hai।
Behind-cover Scan se crouching aura prone Enemy detect naheen hote।
Parachuting Highlights teammates ke saatha share naheen hote।
OB54 Skilll Boosts optional BR enhancements hain aura base Aurora Vision values se alaga hain।

After a successful help-up, the helped-up teammate recovers 60 HP over 3 seconds.
currentHi: Teammates ko help up karane kee Speed 70% badha jaatee hai।
saphala Help-up ke baada usa teammate ko 3 seconds men 60 HP vaapasa milatee hai।
notesEn: The HP recovery is applied to the teammate who was successfully helped up.
notesHi: HP Recovery usee teammate ko milatee hai jise saphalataapoorvaka help up kiyaa gayaa ho।

OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes reworked to +70% help-up speed, 60s cooldown and 100 HP recovered by the helped-up teammate over 3s.

historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Help-up Speed 25% se badhaakara 30%; saphala Rescue ke baada HP Recovery 40 HP se badhaakara 5s men 50 HP kee gaee।

After a successful help-up, keep the rescued teammate with the squad while the 60 HP recovery is applied over 3 seconds.
Track the 90-second cooldown and coordinate the next rescue window rather than assuming Vital Vibes is always available.
tacticalHi: Teammate Knockdown hone para cover ke peechhe surakshita Help-up ko priority den; Thiva kee 70% faster Help-up Speed se Rescue ke dauraana squad ko kama samaya taka exposed rahanaa padataa hai।
Successful Help-up ke baada rescued teammate ko squad ke saatha rakhen, taaki use 3 seconds men milane vaalee 60 HP Recovery kaa phaayadaa mila sake।
90-second Cooldown kaa dhyaana rakhen aura agalee Rescue Window coordinate karen; Vital Vibes ko hara samaya available na maanen।
strengthsEn: Increases teammate help-up speed by 70%, reducing the time needed to complete a rescue.
The successfully helped-up teammate receives 60 HP over 3 seconds.
strengthsHi: Teammate Help-up Speed 70% badhaatee hai, jisase Rescue pooraa karane men kama samaya lagataa hai।
saphalataapoorvaka help up hue teammate ko 3 seconds men 60 HP milatee hai।
limitationsEn: The ability has a 90-second cooldown.
The 60 HP recovery applies only after a successful help-up.
It does not provide a direct benefit while all teammates are already standing.
limitationsHi: isa Ability kaa Cooldown 90 seconds hai।
60 HP Recovery sirpha successful Help-up ke baada milatee hai।
jaba sabhee teammates pahale se khade hon, taba yaha seedhaa koee phaayadaa naheen detee।

Dimitri and allies inside the zone recover 10 HP per second.
When Dimitri or an ally is downed inside the zone, self-recovery automatically starts when needed.
The zone lasts 12 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
currentHi: 3.5m Radius vaalaa Healing Zone banaataa hai।
Zone ke andara Dimitri aura allies hara second 10 HP recover karate hain।
Zone ke andara Dimitri yaa koee ally Knockdown ho jaae, to jaroorata padane para Self-recovery apane aapa shuroo ho jaataa hai।
Zone 12 seconds taka rahataa hai। Cooldown: 90 seconds।

During self-recovery, players can move and no longer lose HP (OB34).
Garena does not publish a separate maximum number of self-recovery activations within one zone.

Self-recovery ke dauraana players move kara sakate hain aura unakee HP kama naheen hotee (OB34)।
eka Zone ke andara Self-recovery kitanee baara activate ho sakataa hai, isakee maximum snkhyaa Garena publish naheen karataa।

historyHi: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Healing Heartbeat introduce huaa — 3.5m Healing Zone, 3 HP/s, maximum level para 15s taka Duration aura 60s Cooldown; Knock hue users aura allies khuda Self-recover kara sakate the।
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery ko behatara kiyaa gayaa, taaki isake dauraana players binaa HP khoe move kara saken।

agara Zone ke andara koee teammate Knockdown ho jaae, to bataaen ki usakaa Self-recovery apane aapa shuroo ho sakataa hai; yaha na maanen ki vaha jagaha interruption se pooree taraha safe hai।

Can automatically start self-recovery for downed players inside the zone.
strengthsHi: Active Zone ke dauraana Dimitri aura aasapaasa ke allies ko HP Recovery milatee hai।
Zone ke andara Knock hue players kaa Self-recovery apane aapa shuroo kara sakataa hai।
limitationsEn: The support area is limited to a 3.5m radius and lasts 12 seconds.
The 90-second cooldown means the zone is not continuously available.
limitationsHi: Support Area sirpha 3.5m Radius taka seemita hai aura 12 seconds taka rahataa hai।
90-second Cooldown ke kaarana Zone lagaataara available naheen rahataa।

name: Skyler
introEn: Active sonic-wave skill that damages Gloo Walls in an area and can store up to two charges.
introHi: eka Active Sonic-wave Skilll, jo Area men Gloo Walls ko Damage karatee hai aura maximum do Charges store kara sakatee hai।
currentEn: Unleashes a sonic wave forward; OB55 states that the actual skill-effect range is over 100m, but does not publish an exact distance.
When the wave hits an obstacle, it explodes and deals 500 DMG per second to Gloo Walls within a 4m radius.
The damage effect lasts 6 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Up to 2 skill charges can be stored.
HP recovery is not included in the current base-skill values used here; the OB38 rework removed Skyler's healing effect.
currentHi: aage kee tarapha Sonic Wave chhodataa hai; OB55 ke mutaabika Skilll kaa actual effect range 100m se jyaadaa hai, lekina exact distance publish naheen kee gaee।
Wave kisee obstacle se takaraane para explode hotee hai aura 4m Radius ke andara Gloo Walls ko hara second 500 DMG detee hai।
Damage Effect 6 seconds taka rahataa hai। Cooldown: 45 seconds। Maximum 2 Skilll Charges store ho sakatee hain।
yahaan istemaala kie gae current base-Skilll values men HP Recovery shaamila naheen hai; OB38 rework men Skyler kaa Healing Effect hataa diyaa gayaa thaa।
notesEn: OB55 says the skill-effect visibility was extended to match the actual range of over 100m. Garena does not publish the exact range.

OB54 introduced two optional BR Skill Boosts: Sticky Rhythm creates a small area that follows the nearest enemy and damages Gloo Walls inside it; Split Rhythm searches for Gloo Walls within 75m, locks onto target walls for 15s and sends waves toward up to 3 walls. Exact damage values for these boosts are not published.
Only one Skill Boost option can be selected for the skill in a match.
OB47 added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls; OB49 added an obstacle indicator to the aiming line.
notesHi: OB55 ke mutaabika Skilll Effect kee visibility ko actual range yaanee 100m se jyaadaa ke anusaara badhaayaa gayaa। Garena exact range publish naheen karataa।

OB54 men do optional BR Skilll Boosts jode gae: Sticky Rhythm eka chhotaa Area banaataa hai jo sabase najadeekee Enemy ke peechhe chalataa hai aura usake andara Gloo Walls ko Damage karataa hai; Split Rhythm 75m ke andara Gloo Walls khojataa hai, 15s taka target walls ko lock karataa hai aura maximum 3 walls kee tarapha waves bhejataa hai। ina boosts kee exact Damage values publish naheen kee gaeen।
eka match men Skilll ke lie sirpha eka Skilll Boost option chunaa jaa sakataa hai।
OB47 men Gloo Walls kee tarapha Aim Assistance jodee gaee; OB49 men Aiming Line para Obstacle Indicator jodaa gayaa।
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): At maximum level, cooldown increased from 40s to 60s; each deployed Gloo Wall granted HP recovery, up to 9 points, and recovery effects did not stack.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Reworked into area damage over time; maximum wave range 100m, 3.5m damage radius, 4s duration and 50s cooldown. HP recovery was removed.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage radius increased from 3.5m to 4m; duration increased from 4s to 5s; cooldown reduced from 50s to 45s.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration increased from 5s to 6s; cooldown reduced from 45s to 40s.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Added up to 2 stored charges; published values were 500 DMG/s within 4m for 6s, with a 45s cooldown and up to 100m wave range.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Added an obstacle indicator to the skill's aiming line.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Added optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm and Split Rhythm.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Extended skill-effect visibility to match the actual range of over 100m; the exact range was not published.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Maximum Level para Cooldown 40s se badhaakara 60s kiyaa gayaa; hara deployed Gloo Wall se maximum 9 points taka HP Recovery milatee thee aura Recovery Effects stack naheen hote the।
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Area Damage over Time men rework kiyaa gayaa; maximum Wave Range 100m, Damage Radius 3.5m, Duration 4s aura Cooldown 50s huaa। HP Recovery hataa dee gaee।
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage Radius 3.5m se badhaakara 4m; Duration 4s se badhaakara 5s; Cooldown 50s se ghataakara 45s kiyaa gayaa।
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration 5s se badhaakara 6s; Cooldown 45s se ghataakara 40s kiyaa gayaa।
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Maximum 2 Stored Charges jodee gaeen; published values 4m ke andara 6s taka 500 DMG/s, 45s Cooldown aura maximum 100m Wave Range theen।
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Gloo Walls kee tarapha Aim Assistance jodee gaee।
OB49 (21 May 2025): Skilll kee Aiming Line para Obstacle Indicator jodaa gayaa।
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Optional BR Skilll Boosts Sticky Rhythm aura Split Rhythm jode gae।
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Skilll Effect Visibility ko 100m se jyaadaa actual range ke anusaara badhaayaa gayaa; exact range publish naheen kee gaee।

hiddenMechanics.text: Riptide Rhythm receives aim assistance toward Gloo Walls (OB47).
An obstacle indicator appears on the aiming line (OB49).

tacticalEn: Communicate the intended route before relying on a Gloo Wall interaction; teammates should know which area is being affected.
Treat the exact wave range as unpublished: OB55 confirms it is over 100m but gives no precise distance.
tacticalHi: Gloo Wall interaction para nirbhara hone se pahale intended route call karen, taaki teammates ko pataa ho ki kisa Area para effect padegaa।
Wave kee exact Range ko unpublished maanen: OB55 sirpha confirm karataa hai ki yaha 100m se jyaadaa hai, exact distance naheen bataataa।
strengthsEn: The sonic-wave effect can affect Gloo Walls within a 4m radius for 6 seconds.
The skill can store up to two charges.
strengthsHi: Sonic-wave Effect 4m Radius ke andara Gloo Walls ko 6 seconds taka prabhaavita kara sakataa hai।
Skilll maximum do Charges store kara sakatee hai।
limitationsEn: The exact actual range above 100m is not published by Garena.
The skill has a 45-second cooldown; stored charges do not make it continuously available.
limitationsHi: 100m se jyaadaa kee exact actual Range Garena ne publish naheen kee hai।
Skilll kaa Cooldown 45 seconds hai; Stored Charges hone kaa matalaba yaha naheen ki Skilll lagaataara available rahegee।

name: Xayne
introEn: Active skill that grants temporary Shield Points, which refill and refresh the skill duration when Xayne knocks down an enemy.
introHi: eka Active Skilll, jo temporary Shield Points detee hai। Xayne ke Enemy ko Knockdown karane para Shield Points phira bhara jaate hain aura Skilll Duration reset ho jaatee hai।
currentEn: Enters the Xtreme state and instantly gains 70 temporary Shield Points for 15 seconds.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the temporary Shield Points from this skill back to 70 and resets the state duration.
When the state ends, the Shield Points gained through this skill are removed. Cooldown: 75 seconds.
currentHi: Xtreme State activate hotee hai aura turnta 15 seconds ke lie 70 temporary Shield Points milate hain।
isa State ke dauraana hara enemy Knockdown para isa Skilll ke temporary Shield Points vaapasa 70 ho jaate hain aura State Duration reset ho jaatee hai।
State khatma hone para isa Skilll se mile Shield Points hata jaate hain। Cooldown: 75 seconds।

rows.value: Garena does not publish this value

notesEn: The temporary Shield Points from Xtreme Encounter are removed when the state ends; they are not permanent HP.
Each enemy knockdown during the active state restores this skill's temporary Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
Garena does not publish a maximum number of duration refreshes.
notesHi: Xtreme Encounter se mile temporary Shield Points, State khatma hone para hata jaate hain; ye permanent HP naheen hain।
Active State ke dauraana hara enemy Knockdown para isa Skilll ke temporary Shield Points vaapasa 70 ho jaate hain aura Duration reset hotee hai।
Duration kitanee baara maximum refresh ho sakatee hai, yaha Garena publish naheen karataa।
historyEn: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): Introduced with 80 temporary HP, up to 100% increased damage to Gloo Walls and shields, 10s duration and 100s cooldown at maximum level.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 100% to 130%; duration increased from 10s to 15s. Maximum cooldown remained 100s.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP increased from 80 to 120; maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 130% to 200%; duration reduced from 15s to 6s.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Reworked from temporary HP to 60 temporary Shield Points for 12s; each enemy knockdown restored the shield to 60 and reset duration; cooldown became 75s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points reduced from 60 to 50; duration remained 12s and cooldown remained 75s.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points increased from 50 to 70 and duration increased from 12s to 15s; cooldown remained 75s.
historyHi: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): 80 temporary HP, Gloo Walls aura Shields para maximum 100% extra Damage, 10s Duration aura maximum level para 100s Cooldown ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa।
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/Shield Damage Bonus 100% se badhaakara 130%; Duration 10s se badhaakara 15s kee gaee। Maximum Cooldown 100s hee rahaa।
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP 80 se badhaakara 120; Maximum Gloo Wall/Shield Damage Bonus 130% se badhaakara 200%; Duration 15s se ghataakara 6s kee gaee।
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Temporary HP kee jagaha 12s ke lie 60 temporary Shield Points die gae; hara enemy Knockdown para Shield 60 taka refill aura Duration reset hotee thee; Cooldown 75s huaa।
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points 60 se ghataakara 50 kie gae; Duration 12s aura Cooldown 75s rahe।
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points 50 se badhaakara 70 aura Duration 12s se badhaakara 15s kee gaee; Cooldown 75s rahaa।
tacticalEn: Tell teammates when the temporary Shield Point state begins and when it expires so they do not mistake it for permanent protection.
A knockdown during the active state refreshes the Shield Points and duration; the profile does not assume a maximum refresh count.
tacticalHi: Teammates ko bataaen ki temporary Shield Point State kaba shuroo aura khatma hotee hai, taaki ve ise permanent Protection na samajhen।
Active State ke dauraana Knockdown hone para Shield Points aura Duration refresh hote hain; profile kisee maximum refresh count kaa daavaa naheen karatee।
strengthsEn: Grants 70 temporary Shield Points for a 15-second state.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the skill's Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
strengthsHi: 15-second State ke lie 70 temporary Shield Points detee hai।
State ke dauraana hara enemy Knockdown para Skilll ke Shield Points vaapasa 70 ho jaate hain aura Duration reset hotee hai।
limitationsEn: Shield Points gained from the skill are removed when the state ends.
The cooldown is 75 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum refresh count.
limitationsHi: State khatma hone para Skilll se mile Shield Points hata jaate hain।
Cooldown 75 seconds hai aura maximum refresh count Garena publish naheen karataa।

name: Lila
introEn: Passive that decelerates enemies and vehicles shot with rifles, freezing them and generating Gloo Walls upon knockdown.
introHi: eka Passive Skilll, jo Rifles se hit hue Enemy aura Vehicles kee Speed kama karatee hai। Knockdown hone para Enemy freeze ho jaate hain aura extra Gloo Walls milatee hain।
currentEn: When hitting enemies or vehicles with rifles or marksman rifles, reduces the enemies' movement speed by 10% or the vehicles' acceleration by 80% for 3 seconds. If the enemy is knocked down while decelerated, freezes them for up to 3 seconds and obtains 2 extra Gloo Walls.
currentHi: Rifles yaa Marksman Rifles se Enemy yaa Vehicles ko hit karane para Enemy kee Movement Speed 10% yaa Vehicles kee Acceleration 80% kama ho jaatee hai। yaha Effect 3 seconds taka rahataa hai। Slow hue Enemy ko Knockdown karane para vaha maximum 3 seconds ke lie freeze ho jaataa hai aura 2 extra Gloo Walls milatee hain।
notesEn: The OB47 patch removed the original 10-second cooldown, making the skill continuously active upon landing successful rifle shots.
notesHi: OB47 Patch ne original 10-second Cooldown hataa diyaa, isalie saphala Rifle Hits lagane para Skilll lagaataara active rahatee hai।
historyEn: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduced. OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle decel 50% to 80%, removed 10s skill cooldown. OB49 (21 May 2025): Gloo Wall reward upon knock increased from 1 to 2.
historyHi: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduce kiyaa gayaa। OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle Deceleration 50% se badhaakara 80%; 10s Skilll Cooldown hataayaa gayaa। OB49 (21 May 2025): Knock para Gloo Wall Reward 1 se badhaakara 2 kiyaa gayaa।

rowsHi.hi: Enemy kee Movement Speed men kamee

tacticalEn: Use rifle hits to slow a moving enemy before your squad commits; a knock while slowed grants extra Gloo Walls for the next cover/rotation.
tacticalHi: Squad ke commit karane se pahale moving Enemy para Rifle Hits lagaakara usakee Speed kama karen; Slow rahate hue Knockdown karane para agalee cover yaa rotation ke lie extra Gloo Walls milatee hain।
strengthsEn: Repeated rifle hits can apply the slow without a cooldown; knockdown reward supports cover economy.
strengthsHi: Repeated Rifle Hits binaa Cooldown ke Slow apply kara sakatee hain; Knockdown Reward se cover ke options badhate hain।
limitationsEn: The freeze and Gloo Wall reward require a knock while the target is decelerated; the slow alone does not guarantee either.
limitationsHi: Freeze aura Gloo Wall Reward tabhee milate hain jaba target Decelerated rahate hue Knockdown ho; sirpha Slow lagane se inamen se koee Effect pakkaa naheen hotaa।

name: Maro
introEn: Passive that scales weapon damage based on the distance to the target and deals extra damage to marked enemies.
introHi: eka Passive Skilll, jo target se dooree ke hisaaba se Weapon Damage badhaatee hai aura Mark hue Enemy ko extra Damage detee hai।
currentEn: Damage increases with distance, up to a maximum of 20%. Damage to marked enemies increases by 5%.
currentHi: dooree badhane ke saatha Damage badhataa hai, maximum 20% taka। Mark hue Enemy ko 5% extra Damage milataa hai।
notesEn: Highly synergistic with information-gathering characters like Moco and Shirou.
notesHi: Moco aura Shirou jaise Information dene vaale characters ke saatha isakaa achchhaa taalamela hai।
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): Damage to marked enemies increased from 3.5% to 5%. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum distance damage bonus nerfed from 25% to 20%.
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): Mark hue Enemy ko Damage 3.5% se badhaakara 5% kiyaa gayaa। OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum Distance Damage Bonus 25% se ghataakara 20% kiyaa gayaa।
tacticalEn: Pair with teammate information marks; maintain distance when the engagement allows to benefit from the distance-scaled bonus.
tacticalHi: Teammate ke Information Marks ke saatha ise use karen; fight men maukaa mile to dooree banaae rakhen, taaki distance-based Bonus kaa phaayadaa mile।
strengthsEn: Combines distance scaling with a separate marked-target bonus; passive has no cooldown.
strengthsHi: Distance Scaling ke saatha Mark hue target para alaga Bonus bhee milataa hai; Passive kaa Cooldown naheen hai।
limitationsEn: The maximum distance bonus scales with range and is not the full 20% at every distance; close-range fights reduce its value.
limitationsHi: Maximum Distance Bonus dooree ke saatha badhataa hai aura hara Range para pooraa 20% naheen milataa; close-range fights men isakaa phaayadaa kama hotaa hai।

name: Shirou
introEn: Passive that marks attackers who hit the user and grants massive armor penetration on the first retaliatory shot.
introHi: eka Passive Skilll, jo aapako hit karane vaale attackers ko mark karatee hai aura javaabee pahalee Shot para bahuta jyaadaa Armor Penetration detee hai।
currentEn: When hit by an enemy from within 100m, the attacker is marked for 8 seconds. Intel is shared with teammates. The first shot on marked enemies has 100% additional armor penetration. Maximum of 4 markings active at once.
currentHi: 100m ke andara maujooda Enemy se Hit hone para attacker 8 seconds ke lie mark ho jaataa hai। yaha jaanakaaree teammates ke saatha share hotee hai। Mark hue Enemy para pahalee Shot ko 100% extra Armor Penetration milatee hai। eka samaya men maximum 4 Marks active raha sakate hain।

rows.value: Garena does not publish current cooldown

notesEn: The mark is universally visible to all teammates. Garena has not republished the cooldown value since it was reduced to 10 seconds in OB36.
notesHi: Mark sabhee teammates ko dikhaaee detaa hai। OB36 men Cooldown 10 seconds kie jaane ke baada Garena ne isakee value dobaaraa publish naheen kee hai।
historyEn: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m to 100m, Armor pen to 100%, Cooldown 25s to 10s. OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Marking duration 10s to 8s, Max markings explicitly capped at 4.
historyHi: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m se badhaakara 100m, Armor Penetration 100% aura Cooldown 25s se ghataakara 10s kiyaa gayaa। OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Marking Duration 10s se ghataakara 8s; Maximum Marks kee limit 4 taya kee gaee।
tacticalEn: When your squad is hit, use the shared mark to call the attacker's location and coordinate a response; the first shot receives the penetration bonus.
tacticalHi: Squad ko Hit hone para shared Mark se attacker kee location call karen aura javaabee action coordinate karen; pahalee Shot ko Penetration Bonus milataa hai।
strengthsEn: Attacker information is shared teamwide; the first retaliatory shot gains 100% additional armor penetration.
strengthsHi: Attacker kee jaanakaaree pooree team ke saatha share hotee hai; javaabee pahalee Shot ko 100% extra Armor Penetration milatee hai।
limitationsEn: Marking requires Shirou to be hit by an enemy within range; it is reactive, not a proactive scan.
limitationsHi: Marking ke lie Shirou ko Range ke andara kisee Enemy se Hit honaa jarooree hai; yaha reactive Skilll hai, pahale se Scan naheen karatee।

name: Chrono
introEn: Active ability that creates an impenetrable static force field blocking incoming and outgoing damage.
introHi: eka Active Ability, jo majaboota aura sthira Force Field banaatee hai। yaha andara aura baahara se aane vaalaa Damage block karatee hai।
currentEn: Creates an impenetrable force field that blocks 1,000 damage. Unable to attack outside enemies from within the field. All effects last for 10 seconds.
currentHi: aisaa Force Field banaataa hai jo 1,000 Damage block karataa hai। Field ke andara se baahara maujooda Enemy para Attack naheen kara sakate। sabhee Effects 10 seconds taka rahate hain।
notesEn: The shield blocks damage from all sources, both inside and out. Enemies can enter the shield dome.
notesHi: Shield andara aura baahara, donon tarapha se aane vaale sabhee sources ke Damage ko block karataa hai। Enemy Shield Dome ke andara aa sakate hain।
historyEn: OB31 (Dec 2021): Removed ability to shoot outward, duration 6s, cooldown 120s. OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s to 8s. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s to 45s, Shield HP 800 to 1000, Duration 8s to 10s.
historyHi: OB31 (Dec 2021): baahara kee tarapha Shoot karane kee Ability hataaee gaee; Duration 6s aura Cooldown 120s kiyaa gayaa। OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s se badhaakara 8s। OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s se ghataakara 45s, Shield HP 800 se badhaakara 1,000 aura Duration 8s se badhaakara 10s kee gaee।
tacticalEn: Use the field to create a temporary protected space for a reset or revive; remember enemies can enter the dome and you cannot shoot outward.
tacticalHi: Reset yaa Revive ke lie Force Field se thodee dera kaa protected area banaaen; yaada rakhen ki Enemy Dome ke andara aa sakate hain aura andara se baahara Shoot naheen kara sakate।
strengthsEn: Blocks up to 1,000 damage and provides a temporary defensive window.
strengthsHi: Maximum 1,000 Damage block karataa hai aura thode samaya ke lie Defensive Window detaa hai।
limitationsEn: The field is static, enemies can enter, and outward attacks are disabled while inside.
limitationsHi: Field eka hee jagaha rahataa hai, Enemy andara aa sakate hain aura isake andara rahate hue baahara kee tarapha Attack naheen kara sakate।

name: Dasha
introEn: Passive that rewards knockdowns with a rapidly decaying rate of fire and movement speed boost.
introHi: eka Passive Skilll, jo Knockdown ke baada Rate of Fire aura Movement Speed kaa Boost detee hai, lekina yaha Boost tejee se kama hotaa jaataa hai।
currentEn: After knocking down an enemy, enter Highlight mode for 10 seconds. Increases rate of fire by 18% and movement speed by 12% (decays quickly). Consecutively knocking down enemies resets the countdown and further boosts rate of fire by 4% and movement speed by 3%.
currentHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karane ke baada 10 seconds ke lie Highlight Mode shuroo hotaa hai। Rate of Fire 18% aura Movement Speed 12% badha jaatee hai (Boost tejee se kama hotaa hai)। lagaataara Knockdown karane para Countdown reset hotaa hai aura Rate of Fire 4% tathaa Movement Speed 3% aura badha jaatee hai।

rows.hi: Rate of Fire kaa Base Bonus

notesEn: Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it.
notesHi: Movement Speed kee eka global maximum limit hai; Skillls, items aura events se milane vaale bonuses isa limit ko paara naheen kara sakate।
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill entirely reworked to Highlight mode (18% RoF, 12% Spd, 6s duration). OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration buffed from 6s to 10s.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skilll ko pooree taraha Highlight Mode men rework kiyaa gayaa (18% RoF, 12% Speed, 6s Duration)। OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration 6s se badhaakara 10s kee gaee।
rowsHi: Rate of Fire kaa Base Bonus
tacticalEn: After a knock, use the Highlight window to reposition or continue pressure; chained knockdowns refresh the timer and increase both bonuses.
tacticalHi: Knock ke baada Highlight Window kaa istemaala reposition karane yaa pressure jaaree rakhane ke lie karen; lagaataara Knockdown karane para Timer reset hotaa hai aura donon Bonuses badhate hain।
strengthsEn: Knockdown-triggered momentum can be chained; no cooldown listed.
strengthsHi: Knockdown se milane vaalaa Momentum lagaataara banaae rakhaa jaa sakataa hai; koee Cooldown listed naheen hai।
limitationsEn: Highlight requires a knockdown to start; its bonuses decay quickly and movement speed remains subject to the global cap.
limitationsHi: Highlight shuroo karane ke lie Knockdown jarooree hai; isake Bonuses tejee se kama hote hain aura Movement Speed global cap ke andara hee rahatee hai।

notesHi: Bonus ke lie Move karanaa aura Fire karanaa eka hee samaya para jarooree hai; khade rahakara Fire karane se yaha Trigger pooraa naheen hotaa।
Official Character Page para chhotaa description diyaa gayaa hai; numeric values Garena ke OB46 Patch Notes men darja hain।
jaanche gae official sources men alaga Duration yaa Cooldown publish naheen kiyaa gayaa hai।

OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement-speed bonus increased from 30% to 50%; accuracy set to 60%.
historyHi: OB28 (Jun 2021): D-Bee ko Bullet Beats ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa।
OB35 (20 Jul 2022): Movement Speed Bonus 10% se badhaakara 20%; Accuracy 20% se badhaakara 45% kee gaee।
OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement Speed Bonus 30% se badhaakara 50%; Accuracy 60% taya kee gaee।

Squad men reposition karate samaya teammates ko call den, taaki unhen aapakee movement kee jaanakaaree rahe।

No active-skill activation input is required.

Active Skilll ko manually activate karane kee jaroorata naheen hai।
limitationsEn: The effect is conditional and does not apply when the character is stationary.
The official sources checked do not specify a separate duration or cooldown.
limitationsHi: yaha Effect condition para nirbhara hai aura stationary rahane para laagoo naheen hotaa।
jaanche gae official sources men alaga Duration yaa Cooldown naheen diyaa gayaa hai।

name: LUQUETA
introEn: A passive ability that permanently raises maximum Shield Points with each elimination, up to a capped bonus.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo hara Elimination para maximum Shield Points badhaatee hai। isakaa Bonus eka taya Limit taka hee stack hotaa hai।
currentEn: Each elimination increases maximum Shield Points by 15. The bonus stacks up to 45 Shield Points in total and is cleared when the player is eliminated or the round resets.
currentHi: hara Elimination para maximum Shield Points 15 badhate hain। Bonus kula 45 Shield Points taka stack hotaa hai aura player ke eliminate hone yaa Round reset hone para hata jaataa hai।

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

The effect is personal to the player using Luqueta; it is not described as a squad-wide reward.
